news.headline: What to expect from uniQure's upcoming Huntington's gene therapy readout
news.summary: STAT previewed uniQure's promised four-year AMT-130 data (dataset cut June 30, 2026, covering 12 high-dose and 12 low-dose patients plus 3 additional high-dose patients with 3-year follow-up, benchmarked against the Enroll-HD natural history cohort), due before the end of Q3 2026. As of the article, the readout had not yet been released, with investors watching whether durability holds up versus the previously reported 3-year, 75% cUHDRS slowing (p=0.003).

news.headline: Analysts raise uniQure (QURE) price targets after BLA filing
news.summary: Following the AMT-130 BLA submission, Barclays upgraded QURE to Overweight and lifted its price target to $65 (from $25), Mizuho raised its target to $68 (Outperform), and HC Wainwright raised its target to $80 (Buy); consensus among ~12 analysts stood near $69.51 with a 'Strong Buy' rating.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Submission of Biologics License Application for Ifezuntirgene Inilparvovec (AMT-130) in Huntington's Disease
news.summary: uniQure submitted a BLA to the FDA seeking accelerated approval of AMT-130 (INN: ifezuntirgene inilparvovec) for Huntington's disease and requested priority review, alongside a Marketing Authorisation Application to the UK MHRA; both filings are supported by the 3-year Phase I/II data showing a 75% slowing of disease progression on cUHDRS versus a propensity-matched external control (p=0.003).

news.headline: uniQure Charts Accelerated Path With AMT-130
news.summary: Coverage reaffirmed that uniQure's confirmatory post-approval trial design was narrowed toward a randomized, standard-of-care-controlled study (away from the ethically contested sham-surgery option) and that the company remained on track to file its BLA in Q3 2026 after aligning with the FDA on an accelerated approval pathway using cUHDRS as an intermediate endpoint.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.8 million and a net loss of $81.1 million, with cash and investments of $810.3 million (up from $622.5 million) expected to fund operations into 2030, including confirmatory trials and a potential AMT-130 launch; management reiterated plans to present four-year AMT-130 data and submit the BLA in Q3 2026.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Preliminary Data on the First Cohort in the Phase I/IIa Clinical Trial of AMT-260 in Refractory Mesial Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
news.summary: In six-month follow-up data (cutoff May 29, 2026) from the low-dose cohort of the GenTLE trial, 3 of 6 refractory epilepsy patients treated with AMT-260 achieved 79%-100% reductions in disabling seizures during months four through six, with no treatment-related serious adverse events reported, expanding uniQure's pipeline narrative beyond AMT-130.

catalysts.label: Four-year AMT-130 Phase I/II data readout
catalysts.detail: uniQure has repeatedly promised topline four-year safety/efficacy data (dataset cut June 30, 2026) covering 12 high-dose and 12 low-dose Huntington's patients plus 3 additional high-dose patients with 3-year follow-up, benchmarked against the Enroll-HD natural history cohort. As of September 17-19, 2026 the data had not yet been released; it is the single biggest near-term catalyst, seen as a durability check on the 75% cUHDRS slowing seen at 3 years and a key input for the pending FDA review.

catalysts.label: FDA decision on BLA filing acceptance and priority review
catalysts.detail: The FDA's 60-day filing review period following the September 2, 2026 BLA submission is expected to conclude around early November 2026, at which point the agency will decide whether to formally accept the BLA and whether to grant the requested priority review (6-month review clock) versus standard review (10 months).

catalysts.label: UK MHRA MAA review progress for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure submitted a Marketing Authorisation Application to the UK's MHRA on September 2, 2026, in parallel with the US BLA, following a positive MHRA pre-submission meeting earlier in 2026. Timeline and any accelerated-assessment designation from MHRA have not yet been detailed by the company.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA action date (PDUFA) for AMT-130 accelerated approval
catalysts.detail: If the FDA accepts the BLA and grants priority review, analysts estimate a PDUFA action date in late April to early May 2027, which would make AMT-130 the first approved gene therapy for Huntington's disease. An FDA advisory committee meeting is considered likely by management ahead of any decision.

catalysts.label: Design finalization and initiation of confirmatory post-approval trial
catalysts.detail: As part of the accelerated-approval pathway, the FDA required uniQure to finalize the design of a randomized, standard-of-care-controlled confirmatory study (moving away from the earlier contested sham-surgery design) before or shortly after BLA submission; initiation timing and enrollment plans are expected to be clarified as the regulatory review proceeds.

catalysts.label: Potential US commercial launch of AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Management has said existing cash (approximately $810 million as of June 30, 2026) funds operations into 2030, including a potential AMT-130 commercial launch, which the company has flagged as achievable before year-end 2026/in 2027 if priority review and accelerated approval are granted on the expected timeline.

pulse: QURE trades around $44 (roughly $43.56-$45.00 intraday range on September 19, 2026; market cap approximately $3.0-3.2B), up sharply (~93% YTD) on the strength of its AMT-130 regulatory turnaround, with a 52-week range of $8.73-$71.50 reflecting the stock's history of FDA-driven whipsaws. The dominant near-term catalyst is the long-promised four-year AMT-130 Phase I/II Huntington's disease data, due before the end of Q3 2026 (i.e., within days) but not yet released as of September 19; a durable result would reinforce the September 2 BLA/priority-review request and UK MAA filings, while a soft readout could unsettle the market ahead of the FDA's ~60-day filing-acceptance decision expected around early November 2026. Wall Street sentiment is bullish, with recent analyst price-target hikes (Barclays $65, Mizuho $68, HC Wainwright $80) and a well-funded balance sheet (~$810M cash, runway into 2030) supporting the buy-the-dip, event-driven narrative around this potential first-ever gene therapy for Huntington's disease.
